name: research_artifacts
sql:
CREATE TABLE research_artifacts (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      job_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      artifact_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- 'pdf' | 'markdown' | 'json_dossier'
      filename TEXT NOT NULL,
      file_path TEXT NOT NULL,

      content_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
      page_count INTEGER,
      validation_passed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

      FOREIGN KEY (job_id) REFERENCES research_jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    )

name: research_citations
sql:
CREATE TABLE research_citations (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      job_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      citation_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
      source_id TEXT NOT NULL,

      formatted_text TEXT NOT NULL,
      url TEXT,

      verified INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,

name: research_claims
sql:
CREATE TABLE research_claims (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      job_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      statement TEXT NOT NULL,
      category TEXT NOT NULL, -- 'fact' | 'statistic' | 'finding' | 'market_metric'
      verification_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNVERIFIED', -- 'SUPPORTED' | 'PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED' | 'DISPUTED' | 'CONTRADICTED' | 'UNVERIFIED' | 'OUTDATED'
      confidence_score REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.5,
      verification_notes TEXT,
      is_critical INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, exact_quote TEXT, primary_source_id TEXT, verified_at INTEGER,
      FOREIGN KEY (job_id) REFERENCES research_jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    )

name: research_contradictions
sql:
CREATE TABLE research_contradictions (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      job_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      claim_id TEXT,
      source_a_id TEXT,
      source_b_id TEXT,
      disputed_topic TEXT NOT NULL,
      source_a_assertion TEXT,
      source_b_assertion TEXT,
      resolution_strategy TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'disputed_in_report',
      final_disposition TEXT,
      created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
      FOREIGN KEY (job_id) REFERENCES research_jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      FOREIGN KEY (claim_id) REFERENCES research_claims(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
      FOREIGN KEY (source_a_id) REFERENCES research_sources(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
      FOREIGN KEY (source_b_id) REFERENCES research_sources(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
    )

name: research_jobs
sql:
CREATE TABLE research_jobs (

      approved_at INTEGER,
      current_stage TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'IDLE',
      progress INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      estimated_duration_ms INTEGER,
      actual_duration_ms INTEGER,
      budget_usd REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 2.00,
      spent_usd REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,

      sources_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      claims_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      error_message TEXT,
      created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
      updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
      completed_at INTEGER
    )

name: research_plans
sql:
CREATE TABLE research_plans (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      job_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      title TEXT NOT NULL,
      domain TEXT NOT NULL,
      time_sensitivity TEXT,
      target_entities TEXT, -- JSON array
      constraints TEXT, -- JSON array
      subtopics TEXT NOT NULL, -- JSON array of subtopics
      primary_questions TEXT NOT NULL, -- JSON array

      updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,

name: research_quality_checks

CREATE TABLE research_quality_checks (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      job_id TEXT NOT NULL,

      job_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      channel TEXT NOT NULL, -- 'google' | 'tavily' | 'exa' | 'github' | 'academic'

      purpose TEXT NOT NULL, -- 'discovery' | 'deepening' | 'counter_research' | 'fact_check'

      status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
      result_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      duration_ms INTEGER,
      created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
      FOREIGN KEY (job_id) REFERENCES research_jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

name: research_runs

      agent_role TEXT NOT NULL,
      provider TEXT NOT NULL,

      step_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      prompt_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

      duration_ms INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'COMPLETED',
      created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
      FOREIGN KEY (job_id) REFERENCES research_jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    )

name: research_sections
sql:
CREATE TABLE research_sections (

      job_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      section_index INTEGER NOT NULL,

sql:
CREATE TABLE research_sources (

      url TEXT NOT NULL,

      title TEXT,
      author TEXT,
      published_date TEXT,
      category TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'web', -- 'primary_doc' | 'github' | 'academic' | 'news' | 'web'

      created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
      UNIQUE(job_id, url),
      FOREIGN KEY (job_id) REFERENCES research_jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
